_note: Key School Systems embed (build/build_key_systems.py). One entry per system, shown in this order: name, a one-line description of what families use it for, and the https link families should open. To add, remove, reorder or reword a system, change this file in a PR; the embed updates on every site within ~10 minutes of the merge. No personal data: no names, emails or phone numbers. Bump `updated` when you change it.
title: Key School Systems

systems.name: Veracross / SFFS Family Portal
systems.description: Calendars, class lists and the directory, school forms, attendance, report cards and conference sign-ups.

systems.name: Choicelunch
systems.description: Order school lunches and snacks. Orders close at 9 a.m. the day before.

systems.name: Vidigami (School Photo Sharing)
systems.description: The school's photos: classroom, field trips, athletics and the arts. Every family has an account; log in from your Vidigami invitation email.

systems.name: Magnus Health
systems.description: Your child's health record: medical and emergency forms and vaccination records. Required for enrollment.

systems.name: Blackbaud Tuition Management
systems.description: Tuition and fees: every SFFS bill is paid and managed here.

systems.name: Procare (Extended Day / Aftercare)
systems.description: Extended Day sign-in and sign-out, attendance and invoices. Add authorised pick-ups and a payment method here.

systems.name: UltraCamp (Enrichment Classes)
systems.description: Register for enrichment classes, music lessons and Extended Day packages.

systems.name: Ravenna (Admissions)
systems.description: Admissions: inquiries, school tours and sibling applications.
